chapter_seo_title: The Karmic Hellfire Descends: Ji Ning Faces an Unforgivable Sin
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning shatters the Shaoyin clan's Celestial Immortals, but Fiendbreeze Patriarch's mad gamble triggers a massacre of ten billion—and Karmic Hellfire ignites.
og_title: The Flame That Cannot Be Extinguished
og_description: Ji Ning wins the battle but may have lost his soul. Ten billion lives end in a single palm strike—and the universe will not forgive.
twitter_title: The Flame That Cannot Be Extinguished
twitter_description: Ji Ning wins the battle but may have lost his soul. Ten billion lives end in a single palm strike—and the universe will not forgive.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary crimson flame in Xianxia cosmology that burns directly from the soul of a cultivator who has committed mass slaughter of innocents. It cannot be blocked by any physical or magical defense.
A cave-realm magic treasure created by a Celestial Immortal with mastery over the Grand Dao of Space. It contains a stable, small internal dimension for storing or relocating people.
The horned, golden-robed Shaoyin Ancestor, a veteran Celestial Immortal from the Primordial Era who controls a host of venomous beasts and avatars.
A Loose Immortal of the Shaoyin clan whose true body and disciple were killed by Ji Ning. His calculated act of provoking a mass slaughter draws down Karmic Hellfire.
A high-level spatial movement technique that allows a cultivator to instantly travel vast distances, often used to appear behind enemy lines.
